svg.title: Agentic research workflow: input, action, evidence and context
svg.desc: Three compact stages. The Main Agent selects research intent, study control, or design and physical validation. Mathematical, physical and unavailable evidence are collected in an Evidence Store, read by a read-only Reporter, and organized into four context levels that return to the Input Layer.
